contributing_factors.name: Inadequate Training
contributing_factors.description: Insufficient job-specific or safety training provided to the employee

contributing_factors.name: Equipment or Tool Failure
contributing_factors.description: Faulty, poorly maintained, or inappropriate equipment or tools

contributing_factors.name: Human Error
contributing_factors.description: Mistake, carelessness, or failure to follow established procedures

contributing_factors.name: Lack of Supervision
contributing_factors.description: Inadequate or absent oversight during the task or incident

contributing_factors.name: Policy or Procedure Non-Compliance
contributing_factors.description: Failure to follow workplace safety rules, policies, or standard operating procedures

contributing_factors.name: Workplace Stress or Fatigue
contributing_factors.description: Physical or mental exhaustion, overwork, or high-pressure environment

contributing_factors.name: Poor Communication
contributing_factors.description: Miscommunication, delayed information, or lack of clarity between teams or individuals

contributing_factors.name: Environmental or Facility Hazard
contributing_factors.description: Unsafe physical conditions such as poor lighting, wet floors, or extreme temperatures

contributing_factors.name: Organizational Culture or Management Issue
contributing_factors.description: Toxic culture, lack of accountability, or management failures contributing to the incident

contributing_factors.name: System or IT Failure
contributing_factors.description: Technical or software failures that contributed to the incident
